name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN–army fighting in Kivus; no major city fallen
summary: Army and Kabila-led FRN keep fighting in North and South Kivu despite peace tracks; no major city changes hands
state: The Doha and Washington peace tracks have not stopped fighting between the army, allied Wazalendo militias and the FRN, the Kabila-led coalition the UN treats as another name for AFC-M23 (Al Jazeera, 18 Nov). The FRN accuses the government coalition, including Burundian forces, of stepping up drone, air and ground operations across South Kivu, Masisi, Walikale and Lubero (The New Times, 4 Nov). Searches on 22 Nov found no major city changing hands and no confirmed interstate fighting, so Watch holds.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to North and South Kivu. Fighting continues to displace civilians and disrupt aid and trade around Goma and Bukavu.
rubric_hit: Active fighting; no major city captured, no interstate fighting = Watch

drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.

rubric.alert: Capture of a major city, or direct interstate fighting.
rubric.watch: Active fighting or a fragile ceasefire.
rubric.normal: Peace agreements holding; no major offensives.
